description: This Swift source file contains extensions for the ChannelsSettings class, providing UI components and functions related to channel configuration and interactions such as login, logout, refresh, and managing channel-specific sections like WhatsApp. It utilizes SwiftUI views to build the user interface for channel settings.

classes.name: ChannelsSettings
classes.description: A class or struct extended with UI components for managing channel settings and interactions.

methods.name: formSection
methods.description: Creates a labeled section in the form with provided content.

methods.name: channelHeaderActions
methods.description: Provides header action buttons for a given channel, such as logout and refresh.

methods.name: whatsAppSection
methods.description: Builds the UI section specific for WhatsApp channel, including login, QR code display, and relink options.

methods.name: genericChannelSection
methods.description: Builds a generic configuration section for any given channel.

methods.name: configEditorSection
methods.description: Provides UI controls to edit, save, and reload channel configuration.

methods.name: configStatusMessage
methods.description: Displays the configuration status message if available.
